items.title: Claude Code 2.1.331 released
items.text: Added Code Mode support in terminal sessions on Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud's Agent Platform, Microsoft Foundry and Claude Platform on AWS · Added oidc.groups_jsonpath to the Claude apps gateway, to read groups from the matching entries of a list of objects with a small subset of JSONPath (RFC 9535) · Added an API connectivity section to claude doctor that reports whether the API can be reached, with the HTTP status or the error, or says why it wasn't tested · Added a notice when tap-mode voice dictation stops by itself, after 15 seconds without recognized speech or at its 2-minute limit

items.title: Ladybird's first alpha release
items.text: Ladybird is an astonishingly ambitious project: a new browser, in 2026, with its own implementation of most of the key components - HTML parsing, CSS engine, layout, JavaScript, even WebAssembly. It still uses a few external components - things like HarfBuzz for text shaping, Skia for 2D graphics, ffmpeg for video, and SQLite for the things you do with SQLite. Everything else is part of Ladybird, or code brought in from Ladybird's even more ambitious predecessor project SerenityOS .
